meta.name: gemini
meta.description: Cross-model second opinion from Google Gemini — a different AI reviewing the same changes, with deep Google ecosystem knowledge. Three modes: review (pass/fail gate for Google Ads campaigns, SEO metadata, or code), challenge (adversarial stress-test that tries to break your changes), and consult (open Q&A with Gemini on Google Ads strategy, SEO best practices, or implementation questions). Use when the user says "gemini review", "ask gemini", "gemini challenge", "second opinion from gemini", "consult gemini", "stress test with gemini", "what would gemini say", "cross-model review", or "get another opinion". Voice aliases: "gem", "gemini check". Especially useful for Google Ads changes, SEO metadata updates, campaign structure decisions, keyword strategies, and bid/budget changes — Gemini has native Google ecosystem knowledge that complements Claude's analysis.

copy.tagline: 用 Gemini 交叉审核广告、SEO 和代码变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 生态系统中获得第二意见来验证变更
copy.tagline_en: Cross-check ads, SEO, and code changes with Gemini
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a second opinion from Google's ecosystem to validate changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以调用 Google Gemini 对代码、Google Ads 或 SEO 元数据变更进行独立审查。支持三种模式：review（通过/不通过）、challenge（压力测试）、consult（问答咨询）。
howto.when: 当你说出“gemini review”、“ask gemini”、“gemini challenge”等触发词时，或要求对 Google Ads、SEO 元数据、代码变更进行二次审查时触发。

say.text: gemini review 我最近的 Google Ads 广告系列变更
say.note: Gemini 会审查并给出通过/不通过结论。

say.text: gemini challenge 这个 SEO 元数据改动
say.note: Gemini 会尝试找出潜在问题。

say.text: ask gemini 关于关键词策略的建议
say.note: Gemini 会以咨询模式回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call Google Gemini to independently review code, Google Ads, or SEO metadata changes. Three modes: review (pass/fail), challenge (stress test), and consult (Q&A).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "gemini review", "ask gemini", "gemini challenge", or when requesting a second opinion on Google Ads, SEO metadata, or code changes.

say_en.text: gemini review my recent Google Ads campaign changes
say_en.note: Gemini will review and give a pass/fail verdict.

say_en.text: gemini challenge this SEO metadata change
say_en.note: Gemini will try to find potential issues.

say_en.text: ask gemini about keyword strategy advice
say_en.note: Gemini will answer in consult mode.
